title: Su Sigohlom Badai .
intro: Sidroe tokoh di padang pasir jibeudôh keu jijak hôi saboh bansa nyang meukuasa keu jiwoe ubak keubeunaran. Rakyat nyan jituri ngon bangunan-bangunan nyang meugah ngon keukuatan nyang hana meubida. Bahpi lagée nyan keusombongan awaknyan ka jipeubuta awaknyan dan awaknyan hana jitem deungoe. Akhe jih, huköman nyang that-that teuka ateueh awaknyan, nyang teupeuseulamat na kheueh keulompok ubit ureuëng-ureuëng meuiman.
clues: Ulôn geukirém ubak saboh bansa nyang meukuasa nyang tinggai di tanoh-tanoh teuhah dan meusyeuhu deungon keukuasaan jih.
Umat ​​Ulôn jijak seutôt bansa nyang raya nyang laén nyang ka teupeubinasa.
Awaknyan na struktur nyang meugah ngon jipeudong meunara-meunara nyang manyang.
Ulôn hôi awaknyan mangat jiseumah Po teu Elohim nyang Esa, teuma awaknyan hana jitem tinggai beurala-beurala awaknyan.
Huköman nyang keujam teuka ateueh awaknyan, dan na kheueh ureuëng-ureuëng nyang meuiman meusajan ngon ulôn.
Lon nakeuh nyang geukirém keu bansa nyang meukuasa nyang jituri ngon nan Aad.

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
